Netanyahu, Trump Discussed Potential Iran Strikes, Reports Say

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, referred to as 'Bibi', reportedly discussed potential further strikes on Iran with former US President Donald Trump. An unnamed US official cited by Hindustan Times stated that Netanyahu expressed a desire to "go in again." NDTV reported Netanyahu stating that Iran's proxies were also looking to launch attacks on Israel before an upcoming election. Separately, The Telegraph (India) reported that the US military is considering the use of the 'mother of all bombs' for potential strikes on Iran, according to CNN.
